metadata.description: Spread holiday cheer with 50 festive jokes for kids! From Santa’s silly antics to reindeer riddles and snowman puns, this audio is perfect for road trips, cozy nights, or family fun. Kids will love guessing the punchlines and sharing their favorites, keeping everyone laughing all season long!
